name: joblog-long-command-starves-output
description: A job log pane in a narrow workspace column keeps a real output viewport under a long command, and keeps CodeBlock's header (language label and Copy button) reachable when scrolling the command. The command container is bounded and CodeBlock's <pre> scrolls inside it, the virtual list keeps at least half of the log column and a nonzero height, and a short command stays fully visible rather than clipped. The fixtures reproduce JobLog.tsx's PaneScaffold > transcript column > command block > .joblog chain with the real component stylesheets; the long command is the 832-character barrier script the background-jobs browser guard renders, recovered from its retained failure DOM.

allowlist..body: transcript.module.css is prefixed to log-*, so resolved.css has no shared .body selector; the raw sheets both define it and the scaffold body uses panescaffold.module.css.
allowlist..header: codeblock.module.css is prefixed to code-*, so resolved.css has no shared .header selector; the raw sheets both define it and the pane header uses panescaffold.module.css.
allowlist..root: virtuallist.module.css is prefixed to list-*, so resolved.css has no shared .root selector; the raw sheets both define it and the command block uses codeblock.module.css.

mutation.declaration: panes/transcript/transcript.module.css: remove .joblogCommand's max-height (starves output), drop --codeblock-overflow-y: auto (clips command), or move overflow-y: auto back onto .joblogCommand itself (scrolls Copy and language label out of view)
mutation.note: Verified 2026-11-25 at the 402px-wide, 700px-tall pane: removing max-height: 40% collapses the list to 0px and grows the command block to 802px of 602px (bodyScrollHeight 854px); dropping --codeblock-overflow-y: auto leaves pre unscrollable (overflow-y: visible, clientHeight === scrollHeight === 240px); moving overflow-y: auto back onto .joblogCommand keeps the 334px/240px split but scrolls .code-header (-427.8..-395.5) and Copy button (-423.8..-399.8) out of the 121.2..362.0 command box (copyHitClickable: false). With all declarations intact, the long command keeps list 334px / command 240px while pre scrolls and Copy stays hit-testable inside the command box; short stays at list 468px / command 106px.
